discovery_strength: Broad compile/link coverage; exercises allocator, threading, filesystem and plugin-heavy consumers during tool execution
cost_shape: Full toolchain build plus selected tool invocations; large CPU/disk/time
platform_fit: Can use glibc+libgcc_s and target x86_64; cross build can exercise arm link but not board runtime
limits: Upstream already builds LLVM with libc++; compile success weakly covers cancellation/exception branches; full arm execution impractical

discovery_strength: Direct specification, ABI and runtime behavior coverage; feature/config matrix encoded upstream
cost_shape: 8620 libc++ pass tests, 71 libc++abi pass tests, 17 libunwind pass tests before generated/config variants
platform_fit: Strong on x86_64; armv7l needs cross compiler, runtime overlay and an SDB executor adaptation
limits: Exact runnable count NOT_DETERMINED until lit feature probing; tests needing host tools, shell, locale/tzdb, filesystem privileges or unsupported target features may be UNSUPPORTED

discovery_strength: Directly compares libc++ against libstdc++ for selected runtime semantics and failure paths
cost_shape: Small per probe; design/oracle quality dominates
platform_fit: Strong for glibc cancellation, streams, future, locale, allocation and EHABI; already proven in project
limits: Not exhaustive; same result can be wrong on both libraries; timing probes can be flaky

discovery_strength: Explores large input/state spaces and finds divergent outputs/crashes
cost_shape: Harness, normalization, corpus and repeated execution cost
platform_fit: Good for containers, parsing, regex, filesystem, locale and algorithms on x86; board throughput lower
limits: Standard allows unspecified differences; needs semantic oracle and nondeterminism filters

discovery_strength: Finds wrong STL, GLIBCXX/CXXABI dependencies, duplicate typeinfo, symbol versions and prebuilt boundaries before execution
platform_fit: Strong on all target architectures and package corpus
limits: Cannot detect same-symbol semantic differences or header-only behavior

discovery_strength: Detects class layout, vtable and exported signature changes
cost_shape: Medium; needs comparable debug info and suppression policy
platform_fit: Useful for third-party DSOs and dual-build artifacts
limits: Template/header-only and stripped binaries reduce coverage; std types from different namespaces mostly appear simply incompatible

discovery_strength: Observes actual provider, binding order, duplicate runtime/typeinfo and plugin topology
platform_fit: Strong for shared glibc loader and plugin/service processes
limits: Only exercised paths are observed; LD_AUDIT availability/security policy on board NOT_OBSERVED

discovery_strength: Forces allocation failure, cancellation, EINTR, short I/O, thread exit and exception crossings
cost_shape: Medium-to-high harness effort and repeated runs
limits: Injection point fidelity matters; asynchronous cancellation from arbitrary PC can invalidate fixture

discovery_strength: Surfaces source-private APIs and link incompatibility at real build flags
platform_fit: Highest fidelity for build-time migration classification
limits: Still does not execute product runtime paths; build-order/dependency closure required

platform_fit: x86_64 feasible; armv7l sanitizer runtime availability NOT_OBSERVED
limits: Does not identify semantic mismatches without a triggered fault; changes timing
